tasks.label: Check Notifications Stack Status
tasks.command: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name wizzcentral-notifications-staging --region us-east-1 --profile Wizz_stg_UserApp --query 'Stacks[0].StackStatus' --output text

tasks.label: Describe Central Client (Staging)
tasks.command: cd backend && aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id us-east-1_wz7vwZZxz --client-id 17mu2qlqis0qcs1n1n980q7e3j --region us-east-1 --profile Wizz_stg_UserApp --query 'UserPoolClient.{ExplicitAuthFlows:ExplicitAuthFlows,AllowedOAuthFlows:AllowedOAuthFlows,AllowedOAuthScopes:AllowedOAuthScopes,SupportedIdentityProviders:SupportedIdentityProviders,TokenValidityUnits:TokenValidityUnits,RefreshTokenValidity:RefreshTokenValidity,AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient:AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient}' --output json | tee .tmp/central-client.json
